items.rationale: Cost of assessing cause and extent under 5.2.6(b), within the EUR 3,000 cap. Taken at the prior level for this line type (about 524).
Leak location under 5.2.6(a) is covered. It shares the EUR 1,000 per-event cap with the technician time on line 3; the combined estimate stays just under that cap.
On-site technician time is expressly included under 5.2.6(a) and shares the EUR 1,000 cap with line 2. Estimated at 2.5 hrs x about 95/hr.
One vehicle charge per contractor per invoice is admitted under 5.2.6(c), capped at EUR 70 net (about 83 gross).

items.description: Repair of actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3, corrosion or porosity leakage counts as fracture damage for the pipe sections shown to be leaking, so the repair of the two weeping joints is covered. Flat-rate repair priced like the earlier pipe-repair references.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3, sections not themselves shown to be leaking are not covered. 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a) also exclude work on unaffected parts and precautionary improvements.
7.1.9 bars improvement over the pre-loss standard, so the upgrade difference is borne by the policyholder.
This is a separate contractor on its own invoice, so one vehicle charge is admitted under 5.2.6(c), capped at EUR 70 net (about 83 gross).
